name: baatsheet
description: AI-powered Google Forms clone — speak a prompt in Bangla or English and get a production-ready survey. Monorepo root for backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
